description_en: Calls UpdateCollectorName to modify the name of a collector
name: UpdateCollectorName

parameters.help_en: A unique token generated by the client to ensure the idempotence of the request. The value must be unique among different requests and cannot exceed 64 ASCII characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

items.description_en: The fileBeat collection path. Displayed when the collector is deployed on an ECS instance
items.description_zh: fileBeat采集路径。当采集器的部署机器为ECS时显示

configs.description_en: The configuration file information of the collector
configs.description_zh: 采集器的配置文件信息

content.example:
- key: log
 title: Log file content
 description: >
 Contains log file lines.
 ....

dryRun.description_en:
Indicates whether the collector is validated and created. Valid values:

true: Only validated, not updated.
false: Validated and updated
dryRun.description_zh:
是否校验并创建采集器。支持：

true：只校验不更新
false：校验并更新

extendConfigs.description_en: The extended configurations of the collector

configType.description_en:
The configuration type. Valid values:

collectorTargetInstance: the collector Output.
collectorDeployMachine: the machine on which the collector is deployed.
collectorElasticsearchForKibana: the Elasticsearch instance that supports Kibana Dashboard
configType.description_zh:
配置类型。支持：

collectorTargetInstance：采集器Output
collectorDeployMachine：采集器的部署机器
collectorElasticsearchForKibana：支持Kibana仪表盘的Elasticsearch实例信息

enableMonitoring.description_en:
Indicates whether Monitoring is enabled. Displayed when configType is collectorTargetInstance and instanceType is elasticsearch. Valid values:

true: Enabled.
false: Not enabled
enableMonitoring.description_zh:
是否启用Monitoring。当configType为collectorTargetInstance，且instanceType为elasticsearch时显示。支持：

true：启用
false：不启用

groupId.description_en: The machine group ID. Displayed when configType is collectorDeployMachine

host.description_en: The internal-facing access address of Kibana on the private network after Kibana Dashboard is enabled. Displayed when configType is collectorElasticsearchForKibana
host.description_zh: 启用Kibana Dashboard后，Kibana的私网访问地址。当configType为collectorElasticsearchForKibana时显示

items.description_en: The list of access addresses for the instance specified in the collector Output. Displayed when configType is collectorTargetInstance
items.description_zh: 采集器Output指定实例的访问地址列表。当configType为collectorTargetInstance时显示

instanceId.description_en: The instance ID associated with the collector. When configType is collectorTargetInstance, this is the instance ID of the collector Output. When configType is collectorDeployMachines and type is ACKCluster, this is the ACK cluster ID
instanceId.description_zh: 采集器关联的实例ID。当configType为collectorTargetInstance时，为采集器Output的实例ID；当configType为collectorDeployMachines，且type为ACKCluster时，为ACK集群ID

instanceType.description_en: The type of instance specified in the collector Output. Valid values: elasticsearch and logstash. Displayed when configType is collectorTargetInstance
instanceType.description_zh: 采集器Output指定的实例类型，支持：elasticsearch、logstash。当configType为collectorTargetInstance时显示

kibanaHost.description_en: The public network access address of Kibana after Kibana Dashboard is enabled. Displayed when configType is collectorElasticsearchForKibana
kibanaHost.description_zh: 启用Kibana Dashboard后，Kibana的公网访问地址。当configType为collectorElasticsearchForKibana时显示

machines.description_en: The list of ECS machines on which the collector is deployed. Displayed when configType is collectorDeployMachines and type is ECSInstanceId
machines.description_zh: 采集器所部署的ECS机器列表信息。当configType为collectorDeployMachines，且type为ECSInstanceId时显示

agentStatus.description_en: The status of the collector on the ECS instance. Valid values: heartOk (normal heartbeat), heartLost (abnormal heartbeat), uninstalled (not installed), and failed (installation failed)
agentStatus.description_zh: ECS上各采集器的状态。支持：heartOk（心跳正常）、heartLost（心跳异常）、uninstalled（未安装）和failed（安装失败）

instanceId.description_en: The list of ECS machine IDs

protocol.description_en: The transmission protocol. Valid values: HTTP and HTTPS

successPodsCount.description_en: The number of pods that are successfully collected in the ACK cluster. Displayed when configType is collectorDeployMachines and type is ACKCluster
successPodsCount.description_zh: ACK集群所有成功采集的Pod节点数。当configType为collectorDeployMachines，且type为ACKCluster时显示

totalPodsCount.description_en: The total number of pods collected in the ACK cluster. Displayed when configType is collectorDeployMachines and type is ACKCluster
totalPodsCount.description_zh: ACK集群所有采集的Pod节点数。当configType为collectorDeployMachines，且type为ACKCluster时显示

type.description_en:
The type of machine on which the collector is deployed. Displayed when configType is collectorDeployMachine. Valid values:

ECSInstanceId: ECS instance.
ACKCluster: Container Kubernetes cluster
type.description_zh:
采集器部署的机器类型，当configType为collectorDeployMachine时显示。支持：

ECSInstanceId：ECS实例
ACKCluster：容器Kubernetes集群

userName.description_en: The username used to access the instance specified in the collector Output. Default value: elastic. Displayed when configType is collectorTargetInstance or collectorElasticsearchForKibana
userName.description_zh: 采集器Output指定实例的访问用户名，默认为elastic。当configType为collectorTargetInstance或collectorElasticsearchForKibana时显示

gmtCreatedTime.description_en: The time when the collector was created

gmtUpdateTime.description_en: The time when the collector was last updated

resType.description_en: The collector type. Valid values: fileBeat, metricBeat, heartBeat, and audiBeat

resVersion.description_en:
The collector version. The supported versions depend on the type of machine on which the collector is deployed:

ECS: 6.8.5_with_community
ACK: 6.8.13_with_community
resVersion.description_zh:
采集器版本。支持的版本与采集器的部署机器类型相关，具体如下：

ECS：6.8.5_with_community
ACK：6.8.13_with_community

status.description_en: The collector status. Valid values: activing (taking effect) and active (active)
status.description_zh: 采集器状态。支持activing（生效中）和active（已生效）

vpcId.description_en: The ID of the VPC where the collector resides
vpcId.description_zh: 采集器所在的专有网络ID
